verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official Virtual Mail MCP server that external AI assistants like Claude and Cursor connect to, plus an MCP tool catalog. That is the server role, not the ability to plug outside MCP servers into the product. Nothing in the pack shows the product acting as an MCP client or consuming third-party MCP tools, and its in-app AI summaries and labels are an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
